---
title: ""
page-layout: full
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
    <link href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.0/css/all.min.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
    <style>
      .page-hero { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#DCFCE7 0%,#F8FAFC 60%); padding:3.5rem 2rem 3rem; }
      .page-hero-inner { max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; }
      .page-hero h1 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:2.5rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.03em; margin-bottom:0.5rem; }
      .page-hero p { color:#64748B; font-size:0.96rem; }
      .pw { max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 2rem; }
      .aud-row { display:flex; gap:0.6rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:2rem auto 0; max-width:900px; padding:0 2rem; align-items:center; }
      .aud-lbl { font-size:0.82rem; color:#94A3B8; font-weight:600; }
      .achip { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.4rem; padding:7px 16px; border-radius:999px; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; background:#fff; color:#64748B; font-size:0.82rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif; transition:all 0.2s; }
      .achip:hover { border-color:#16A34A; color:#16A34A; }
      .achip.active { background:#16A34A; color:#fff; border-color:#16A34A; box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(22,163,74,0.3); }
      .info-banner { background:#EEF2FF; border:1.5px solid #C7D2FE; border-radius:14px; padding:1rem 1.4rem; font-size:0.88rem; color:#4338CA; margin:1.5rem 0; display:flex; gap:0.8rem; align-items:flex-start; }
      .info-banner i { margin-top:3px; flex-shrink:0; }
      .info-banner a { color:#6366F1; font-weight:600; }
      .course-card { background:#fff; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:1.2rem; transition:all 0.3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }
      .course-card:hover { border-color:#6366F1; box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(99,102,241,0.12); transform:translateY(-4px); }
      .course-card.hidden { display:none; }
      .cc-top { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:1.2rem; padding:1.4rem 1.6rem 1rem; }
      .cc-icon { width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:1.4rem; flex-shrink:0; }
      .cc-title { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.3; margin-bottom:0.3rem; }
      .cc-meta { display:flex; gap:1rem; flex-wrap:wrap; font-size:0.78rem; color:#94A3B8; font-weight:500; }
      .cc-meta span { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.3rem; }
      .cc-meta i { color:#6366F1; }
      .aud-chips { display:flex; gap:0.4rem; margin-top:0.5rem; }
      .at { font-size:0.68rem; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:999px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase; }
      .at-uni { background:#EEF2FF; color:#6366F1; }
      .at-corp { background:#DCFCE7; color:#16A34A; }
      .cc-body { padding:0 1.6rem 1rem calc(1.6rem + 52px + 1.2rem); }
      .cc-body p { font-size:0.88rem; color:#64748B; line-height:1.7; margin-bottom:0.8rem; }
      .topics-btn { background:none; border:none; color:#6366F1; font-size:0.8rem; font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; padding:0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.3rem; }
      .topics-btn i { font-size:0.7rem; transition:transform 0.25s; }
      .topics-btn.open i { transform:rotate(180deg); }
      .topics-list { display:none; margin-top:0.8rem; background:#F8FAFC; border-radius:10px; padding:1rem 1.2rem; }
      .topics-list.open { display:block; }
      .topics-list ul { list-style:none; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:0.4rem 1rem; padding:0; }
      .topics-list ul li { font-size:0.83rem; color:#475569; display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:0.4rem; }
      .topics-list ul li::before { content:"→"; color:#6366F1; font-size:0.72rem; flex-shrink:0; }
      .cc-footer { border-top:1px solid #F1F5F9; padding:0.9rem 1.6rem; background:#FAFAFA; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.5rem; }
      .modes { display:flex; gap:0.4rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
      .mode-tag { font-size:0.72rem; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:#F1F5F9; color:#475569; font-weight:600; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.3rem; }
      .contact-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.4rem; padding:0.45rem 1.2rem; background:#6366F1; color:#fff; border-radius:999px; text-decoration:none; font-size:0.82rem; font-weight:700; transition:all 0.2s; box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(99,102,241,0.3); }
      .contact-btn:hover { background:#4F46E5; transform:translateY(-1px); color:#fff; text-decoration:none; }
      .cta-block { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0D1117,#1E293B); border-radius:20px; padding:2.5rem; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:2rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:2.5rem 0 4rem; }
      .cta-block h3 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:800; color:#fff; margin-bottom:0.3rem; }
      .cta-block p { color:#94A3B8; font-size:0.9rem; margin:0; }
      .cta-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; padding:0.75rem 1.8rem; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366F1,#F97316); color:#fff; border-radius:999px; text-decoration:none; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:700; white-space:nowrap; transition:all 0.25s; box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(99,102,241,0.4); }
      .cta-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(99,102,241,0.5); color:#fff; text-decoration:none; }
      @media(max-width:600px){ .cc-body{padding-left:1.6rem;} .topics-list ul{grid-template-columns:1fr;} .cta-block{flex-direction:column;} }
    </style>

```{=html}
<div class="page-hero fade-up">
  <div class="page-hero-inner">

    <h1>Consulting</h1>

<div class="aud-row fade-up fade-up-1">

    Liên hệ: <a href="mailto:email@example.com">email@example.com</a></span>

</div>

<div class="pw" style="padding-top:0.5rem; padding-bottom:0;">

  <!-- COURSE 1 -->

      <button class="topics-btn" onclick="toggleTopics(this)"><i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i> Nội dung chi tiết</button>
      <div class="topics-list">
        <ul>
          <li>Giới thiệu R và RStudio</li><li>Nhập & làm sạch dữ liệu (tidyverse)</li>
          <li>Thống kê mô tả</li><li>Kiểm định t-test, ANOVA</li>
          <li>Hồi quy tuyến tính & logistic</li><li>Trực quan hoá với ggplot2</li>
          <li>Báo cáo với Quarto / R Markdown</li><li>Giới thiệu tidymodels</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>

        <span class="mode-tag"><i class="fas fa-person-chalkboard"></i> Trực tiếp</span>

        <span class="mode-tag"><i class="fas fa-building-columns"></i> Workshop</span>

      </div>

        </div>

        </div>

<script>
  function toggleTopics(btn) {
    const body = btn.nextElementSibling;
    body.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.innerHTML = body.classList.contains('open')
      ? '<i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i> Ẩn nội dung'
      : '<i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i> Nội dung chi tiết';
  }
  function filterAud(btn, aud) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.achip').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.course-card').forEach(c => {
      c.classList.toggle('hidden', aud !== 'all' && !c.dataset.aud.includes(aud));
    });
  }
</script>
```
